Routines

top source red::momfbd_hesp_fov

SST pipeline

red::momfbd_hesp_fov, cfgfiles [, cfg_tag=string] [, cubefile=string] [, coord=lonarr(2)] [, fov_size=float], iframe=iframe, iscan=iscan, istokes=istokes, ituning=ituning, nmodes=nmodes [, num_points=integer]

Setup for MOMFBD-processing CRISP/CHROMIS in the HeSP FOV as a single subfield.

Parameters

cfgfiles in type=string

Existing MOMFBD config files to modify.

Keywords

cfg_tag in optional type=string default=[xc,yc,size]

A short string to be added to the "cfg" part of the path. A default tag is constructed from the center coordinates of the FOV and the FOV size.

cubefile in optional type=string

The path to a fitscube to be used to select the position of the HeSP FOV. Use one of coord or cubefile.

coord in optional type=lonarr(2)

The center pixel coordinates of the HeSP FOV. Use one of coord or cubefile.

fov_size in optional type=float

The size of the momfbd subfield in arcsec. Default 9 arcsec unless num_points is given.

iframe
iscan
istokes
ituning
nmodes
num_points in optional type=integer

The size of the momfbd subfield in pixels.
